## States

`Default` · `Hover` · `Pressed` · `Focus` · `Disabled`

## Anatomy

- `root`: A disclosure. The header row (`top`) is the button; the whole block takes its states, the way Figma draws them. Values come from each variant's own branch of the Figma read.
- `outline`: The divider underneath.
- `top`: The header row, and the button. Its own browser look goes.
- `left`
- `slot`: The picture.
- `content`
- `text`: The name.
- `job-description`
- `actions`: The chevron at the end, in a 32px round frame.
- `icons-chevron`: Figma's 16px chevron, down when closed and up when open, drawn as a mask. #00d669 in every state.
- `bottom`: The quote. Only there when it's expanded.
- `testimonial`
- `focus-ring`

## When to use

- **Quotes that open.** Used as a testimonial box or a list of quotes: name and role first, and each one opens to show the quote.

## When not to use

- **A quote always on show.** A quote that should always be visible. Put it on the page as text.
- **A long quote.** More than a sentence or three. It's a quote, not an article.

## Behaviour

Closed, it's a row: the picture, the name and the role, a chevron, and a line underneath. Press it and it opens: the header slides 16px right and the quote shows below in `typography/sub-title`. On hover and press the name goes green and the line turns green (2px on hover). Disabled fades it to `opacity/gentle`.

## Accessibility

- **Element**: a `<div>` holding a `<button aria-expanded>` (the header) and the quote, which the button controls with `aria-controls`.
- **Name**: the name and the role, from the button's text.
- **Keyboard**: Tab to the header, Enter or Space opens and closes it.
- **Focus**: a 2px ring, 4px outside the whole block, while the header has `:focus-visible`.

## Content

The name as the person writes it. The role in a few words. The quote in their words, trimmed, never rewritten.

## Where code differs on purpose

| App | What | Why | Taken to design |
|---|---|---|---|
| Portfolio site | The open quote is `non-interactive/foreground/tertiary`, with key phrases in `non-interactive/foreground/primary`. Figma has the whole quote in `non-interactive/foreground/secondary`. | I pick out what matters in each quote, the same way the footer headline does. It's an editorial choice on the site, not a change to the component. | not yet |
| Portfolio site | Under 768px the name and job line wrap instead of staying on one line. The last row has no line at rest. | Figma only has the desktop row, and a long job title runs off a phone screen. The list ends at the next section. | not yet |
| Portfolio site | The 16px slide on hover, press and opening takes `motion/duration/base` with `motion/easing/out`, the same as the Work list's projects. | Without it the row jumps. Motion isn't in the contract yet, so it's the site's, and it matches Projects'. | not yet |
